title: Safari 27.3 Adds Adaptive Dark Mode for Unsupported Sites
summary: Safari 27.3 introduces Adaptive Dark Mode, a WebKit feature that automatically adapts websites lacking dark themes. The capability affects Safari users and frontend developers on sites that have not implemented dark mode. The supplied item does not state availability beyond the version number or explain how the adaptation works.
